title: ghost
content_html:
ghost

In we make ghosts, ghosts pass through us and a wall of memories is continually rebuilt. In a doll story, the photographs can make the doll feel present after the object itself has gone. Where does that sense of presence come from? An afterimage, a recurrent dream and the impression that someone still inhabits a place each suggest a way we might supply something an image seems to contain. we make ghosts

Reading note. Daoism. In chapter 2 of the Zhuangzi, the shadow explains its movements by pointing to something else on which it depends. The ghosts in we make ghosts raise a question about what sustains a presence. A place, an earlier encounter or someone who remembers might all help it endure. What would make it disappear? Zhuangzi, 2
